capability_invariant: Consolidate multiple receipt images into document, item, category, exception, and reconciliation structures.
Use formula-linked document totals with source-displayed currency rounding.
Maintain source-file provenance for every extracted item.

distinctness.source_instance: July three-receipt expense batch from Juniper Bakery, Metro Transit Garage, and Office Corner
distinctness.contamination_guard: Confirm source, values, truth, oracle, perturbation, and reference are verifier-private and were fixed before target-agent evaluation.

protected: A perturbation to one receipt must not change another receipt total
